recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31866 unless a future work group decision reintroduces either structure as a datatype.
issue_request: FHIR-31866 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested reincorporating Statistic datatype elements into Evidence, removing Statistic and OrderedDistribution datatypes, and removing Evidence.distribution.
initial_application: The issue was applied through staged source commits that moved Statistic content into Evidence, removed OrderedDistribution, removed Statistic, and migrated Statistic-related terminology under Evidence; a later same-family FHIR-31564 cleanup repeated the datatype removal after branch divergence.
additional_context: FHIR-31564 is the same change family and records the earlier decision to remove OrderedDistribution rather than add examples. CDS approved the FHIR-31866 resolution on 2021-06-23, and OO minutes on 2021-06-03 did not identify a need to keep Statistic as a separate datatype.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/fhir.ini has Evidence as an active resource and no active Statistic or OrderedDistribution datatype entries, and source/evidence/structuredefinition-Evidence.xml defines Evidence.statistic as backbone content with no Evidence.distribution element.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive-with-Modification decision that removed OrderedDistribution and led to the same datatype-removal source cleanup.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requiring Statistic content to be reincorporated into Evidence and Statistic, OrderedDistribution, and Evidence.distribution to be removed.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed issue request and its R5 application target.

evidence_items.summary: Evidence.statistic is defined in the Evidence StructureDefinition and the Evidence introduction describes statistic as a BackboneElement.
evidence_items.learned: Statistic content is incorporated into Evidence rather than maintained as a standalone datatype.

evidence_items.summary: History shows staged application of FHIR-31866 and later same-family cleanup under FHIR-31564.
evidence_items.learned: The removal was deliberately applied in source, not merely absent by accident.
